properties.title: SWFSC Ichthyoplankton — v2026.09.10
properties.description: Ichthyoplankton (fish eggs and larvae) collected by bongo and manta net tows on CalCOFI cruises, processed by SWFSC.
properties.sci:citation: NOAA Fisheries SWFSC. CalCOFI Ichthyoplankton Database.

table:columns.name: obs_id
table:columns.description: Surrogate key, renumbered globally when the release concatenates the per-dataset shards.

table:columns.name: realm
table:columns.description: `env` for physical/chemical measurements, `bio` for organism observations.

table:columns.name: dataset_key
table:columns.description: Provenance stamp: `provider_dataset`.

table:columns.name: sample_key
table:columns.description: The sampling event this observation came from; joins `sample`.

table:columns.name: grid_key
table:columns.description: CalCOFI station grid cell, denormalized from `sample` so rollups need no join. NULL for region-pooled data.

table:columns.name: cruise_key
table:columns.description: Cruise, denormalized from `sample` so rollups need no join.

table:columns.name: latitude
table:columns.description: Observation latitude (WGS84).

table:columns.name: longitude
table:columns.description: Observation longitude (WGS84).

table:columns.name: datetime
table:columns.description: Observation time (UTC). NULL for region-pooled data with no event time.

table:columns.name: depth_min_m
table:columns.description: Shallowest depth this observation represents.

table:columns.name: depth_max_m
table:columns.description: Deepest depth this observation represents; equal to `depth_min_m` for point measurements (bottle, CTD scan).

table:columns.name: taxon_key
table:columns.description: Global taxon key, `worms:<AphiaID>` or `itis:<TSN>` for birds. NULL for `env` rows. Joins `taxon`.

table:columns.name: life_stage
table:columns.description: Life stage where the source resolves one (larva, adult, juvenile, egg, phyllosoma).

table:columns.name: measurement_type
table:columns.description: Measured quantity; joins the `measurement_type` vocabulary.

table:columns.name: measurement_value
table:columns.description: The measured value, in the units `measurement_type` declares.

table:columns.name: measurement_qual
table:columns.description: Source quality flag, verbatim.

table:columns.name: measurement_prec
table:columns.description: Source-reported precision where available.

table:columns.name: hex_id
table:columns.description: H3 cell at resolution 10, stored as UBIGINT. Aggregate coarser at query time with `h3_cell_to_parent(hex_id, res)` — there is no per-resolution column ladder.

table:columns.name: sample_key
table:columns.description: Globally unique event key, namespaced `dataset_key:sample_type:id` so the same integer id in two datasets — or at two event levels in one dataset — never collides.

table:columns.name: sample_type
table:columns.description: Event grain: `site`, `tow`, `net`, `cast`, `bottle`, `underway`, `transect` or `region_pool`.

table:columns.name: parent_sample_key
table:columns.description: The containing event (net → tow → site; bottle → cast). NULL at the top of the chain. Flat adjacency list: attributes are not inherited.

table:columns.name: root_sample_key
table:columns.description: Top of this event's containment chain; equals `sample_key` for single-level datasets. Use `count(DISTINCT root_sample_key)` to count stations/casts irrespective of grain.

table:columns.name: dataset_key
table:columns.description: Provenance stamp: `provider_dataset`.

table:columns.name: grid_key
table:columns.description: CalCOFI station grid cell. NULL where the dataset has no station assignment (region-pooled phytoplankton).

table:columns.name: site_key
table:columns.description: CalCOFI station natural key as the source records it (line/station, e.g. `090.0 060.0`). Present on 13 of the 18 source event tables, so it is carried on the event dimension rather than lost to consolidation; `grid_key` is the derived grid cell, this is the source's own station id.

table:columns.name: cruise_key
table:columns.description: CalCOFI cruise natural key `YYYY-MM-NODC`.

table:columns.name: order_occ
table:columns.description: Order in which the station was occupied on the cruise. Source spelling varies (`order_occ`, `ord_occ`) and CTD stores it as text; normalised to an integer here.

table:columns.name: latitude
table:columns.description: Event latitude (WGS84).

table:columns.name: longitude
table:columns.description: Event longitude (WGS84).

table:columns.name: datetime
table:columns.description: Event start time (UTC).

table:columns.name: depth_min_m
table:columns.description: Shallowest depth sampled by this event.

table:columns.name: depth_max_m
table:columns.description: Deepest depth sampled by this event.

table:columns.name: tow_type
table:columns.description: Net gear code where the dataset records one (C1/CB/CV/PV oblique or vertical, MT manta); NULL for gears and datasets without one. Needed to compute gear-appropriate CPUE.

table:columns.name: data_stage
table:columns.description: The source's own processing state for this event: `final` (post-cruise calibrations applied) or `preliminary` (**not for publication** — the source warns that oxygen, nitrate and chlorophyll may change significantly once calibrated). Populated by `calcofi_ctd-cast`; NULL where the dataset draws no such distinction, which is not a claim that the data are final.

table:columns.name: geom
table:columns.description: Point geometry minted from `longitude`/`latitude` (OGC:CRS84).

table:columns.name: obs_attribute_id
table:columns.description: Surrogate key.

table:columns.name: dataset_key
table:columns.description: Provenance stamp: `provider_dataset`.

table:columns.name: sample_key
table:columns.description: The sampling event; joins `sample`.

table:columns.name: taxon_key
table:columns.description: Global taxon key; joins `taxon`.

table:columns.name: life_stage
table:columns.description: Life stage the attribution applies to.

table:columns.name: measurement_type
table:columns.description: The attribute being broken down: `body_length`, `stage` or `behavior`.

table:columns.name: bin_value
table:columns.description: Numeric bin — length in mm, stage number. NULL for categorical attributes.

table:columns.name: bin_label
table:columns.description: Category label — stage description, behavior name. NULL for purely numeric bins.

table:columns.name: count
table:columns.description: Number of individuals in this bin.

table:columns.name: measurement_qual
table:columns.description: Source quality flag, verbatim.

table:columns.name: sample_measurement_id
table:columns.description: Surrogate key.

table:columns.name: sample_key
table:columns.description: The sampling event this effort measurement describes; joins `sample`.

table:columns.name: dataset_key
table:columns.description: Provenance stamp: `provider_dataset`.

table:columns.name: measurement_type
table:columns.description: Measured quantity; joins the `measurement_type` vocabulary.

table:columns.name: measurement_value
table:columns.description: The measured value, in the units `measurement_type` declares.

table:columns.name: measurement_qual
table:columns.description: Source quality flag, verbatim.

table:columns.name: taxon_key
table:columns.description: Global taxon key: lowercase authority prefix plus id, `worms:127023` or `itis:176754`.

table:columns.name: worms_id
table:columns.description: WoRMS AphiaID.

table:columns.name: itis_id
table:columns.description: ITIS Taxonomic Serial Number.

table:columns.name: gbif_id
table:columns.description: GBIF backbone taxon key.

table:columns.name: ncbi_id
table:columns.description: NCBI Taxonomy id.

table:columns.name: inat_id
table:columns.description: iNaturalist taxon id.

table:columns.name: scientific_name
table:columns.description: Accepted scientific name.

table:columns.name: common_name
table:columns.description: Common name where one is recorded.

table:columns.name: rank
table:columns.description: Taxonomic rank.

table:columns.name: rank_order
table:columns.description: Ordinal for sorting ranks from kingdom down.

table:columns.name: taxonomic_status
table:columns.description: Status as fetched from the keying authority (accepted, unaccepted, superseded combination, ...). Read it with `status_checked` — before v2026.08.05 this column was the literal string "accepted" on every row, stamped rather than fetched.

table:columns.name: status_checked
table:columns.description: Date `taxonomic_status` was last confirmed against the authority. A status with no check date is not a fact.

table:columns.name: parent_taxon_key
table:columns.description: Lineage parent; walk this to expand a taxon to its descendants.

table:columns.name: kingdom
table:columns.description: Kingdom.

table:columns.name: phylum
table:columns.description: Phylum.

table:columns.name: class
table:columns.description: Class.

table:columns.name: order_taxon
table:columns.description: Order (named `order_taxon` because `order` is a SQL keyword).

table:columns.name: family
table:columns.description: Family.

table:columns.name: notes
table:columns.description: Append-only provenance log, one datestamped line per entry: how each id was resolved and any re-key onto an authority-accepted id (e.g. `itis:174553` Puffinus griseus -> `itis:1255050` Ardenna grisea). The dataset's own original code and name stay in `dataset_taxon`.

table:columns.name: ds_taxon_key
table:columns.description: Key of this crosswalk row, `<dataset-or-known-list>:<local code>`.

table:columns.name: dataset_key
table:columns.description: The dataset whose vocabulary this row belongs to.

table:columns.name: taxon_key
table:columns.description: The global taxon it resolves to; joins `taxon`.

table:columns.name: ds_scientific_name
table:columns.description: Scientific name as the source dataset spells it.

table:columns.name: ds_common_name
table:columns.description: Common name as the source dataset spells it.

table:columns.name: ds_taxa_code
table:columns.description: The dataset's own code, as stored on its measurement rows.

table:columns.name: cruise_uuid
table:columns.description: CalCOFI species identifier, primary key in species table

table:columns.name: date_ym
table:columns.description: Cruise year and month — the YYYY-MM half of cruise_key.

table:columns.name: ship_key
table:columns.description: FK to ship; the natural key of the vessel that ran the cruise.

table:columns.name: _source_file
table:columns.description: Provenance: the source file this row was read from.

table:columns.name: _source_row
table:columns.description: Provenance: 1-based row number within _source_file, so a value can be traced back to its line.

table:columns.name: _ingested_at
table:columns.description: Provenance: UTC timestamp of the ingest run that produced this row.

table:columns.name: _source_uuid
table:columns.description: Provenance: the UUID the source record carried where it minted one.

table:columns.name: cruise_key
table:columns.description: Natural primary key in YYMMKK format (2-digit year + 2-digit month + ship_key)

table:columns.name: year
table:columns.description: Cruise year extracted from date_ym.

table:columns.name: month
table:columns.description: Cruise month extracted from date_ym.

table:columns.name: ship_name
table:columns.description: Ship name as resolved against NODC ship registry.

table:columns.name: ship_nodc
table:columns.description: NODC ship code.

table:columns.name: ichthyo
table:columns.description: Distinct sites sampled by SWFSC ichthyo on this cruise.

table:columns.name: bottle
table:columns.description: Distinct sites sampled by CalCOFI bottle casts on this cruise.

table:columns.name: ctd_cast
table:columns.description: Distinct sites sampled by CTD casts on this cruise.

table:columns.name: dic
table:columns.description: Distinct sites with NCEI DIC samples on this cruise.

table:columns.name: lookup_id
table:columns.description: Sequential integer primary key

table:columns.name: lookup_type
table:columns.description: Category: 'egg_stage', 'larva_stage', or 'tow_type'

table:columns.name: lookup_num
table:columns.description: Numeric code for the lookup value

table:columns.name: lookup_chr
table:columns.description: Character code for the lookup value (e.g. YOLK, PREF)

table:columns.name: description
table:columns.description: Human-readable description of the lookup value

table:columns.name: grid_key
table:columns.description: Natural primary key (e.g. st60-ln80 or st60-ln80_hist for historical)

table:columns.name: station
table:columns.description: Offshore component of CalCOFI coordinate system

table:columns.name: line
table:columns.description: Alongshore component of CalCOFI coordinate system

table:columns.name: shore
table:columns.description: Shore classification (nearshore, offshore, etc.)

table:columns.name: pattern
table:columns.description: Station pattern: 'standard' or 'historical'

table:columns.name: spacing
table:columns.description: Station spacing in nautical miles

table:columns.name: zone
table:columns.description: Combined shore-pattern zone label

table:columns.name: area_km2
table:columns.description: Grid cell area

table:columns.name: geom
table:columns.description: Polygon geometry (WGS84 EPSG:4326) of grid cell

table:columns.name: geom_ctr
table:columns.description: Point geometry (WGS84 EPSG:4326) of grid cell centroid
